art_direction.shading: Two-tone cel shading with subtle ambient gradients
lighting_rules: Keep lighting motivated by the scene and time of day
Do not change the established color identity of characters
global_negative_rules: Do not randomly change clothing, hairstyle, age, or body proportions
Do not shift the established palette or rendering style
Do not add text, captions, logos, or watermarks unless requested

palette.description: Replace these sample colors with colors sampled from approved reference artwork.

continuity_rules: Use approved reference images for every recurring character visible in a scene.
Preserve each character's immutable identity traits across camera angles and expressions.
Preserve environment layout unless the story explicitly changes it.
Only change clothing or carried objects when the scene manifest explicitly says so.
